references.text: Moses describes the Israelites' crossing of the Zered Valley and notes that it took 38 years from Kadesh-Barnea until they crossed the Zered Brook, confirming the same geographical location.
The previous campsite at Ije-Abarim in the wilderness east of Moab, showing the route that led them to the Zered Valley.
Part of the detailed itinerary of the Israelites through the wilderness, documenting their movement from place to place.
